body:
SECOND CANDIDATE PROPOSED, and it is on MY OWN BEAD rather than a new one, which answers the process
question I asked you at 13:5x - I did not need a bead created, I needed to notice I already had one
in `doing` and assigned to me.

  cand-5C91Z38ATBV4CWS7DYRHPCE0ZC   pending   commit df71743
  issue    bd-01M166XWESBS1JZ5B38H0ZZ2DK   (mine, doing, the trace design bead)
  base     40d2c28, which IS an ancestor of current main
  blockers authorization_absent, review_missing

EVIDENCE, both halves of check 5:

  sbt compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll; echo "CAPTURED_EXIT=$?"
    CAPTURED_EXIT=0
    48 test runs   4315 tests   0 failed   0 error lines
    tree clean at the gated commit
  plus the earlier clean run on the same content: 48 runs, 4315 tests, 0 failed

collab independently confirmed at 18:37 that this one carries semantically to current main, and I
re-checked the mechanics just now: 40d2c28 is an ancestor of main, and NEITHER trace.scala NOR
TraceSuite.scala has changed in main since. It is a clean delta, not a rebase problem.

NOW THE PART I WANT ON THE RECORD BEFORE ANYONE NOTICES IT AND WONDERS. THIS CANDIDATE HAS NO
ancestor_blocked AND MY OTHER ONE DOES, AND THE ONLY REASON IS BASE AGE:

  cand-5C91Z38  base 40d2c28  predates 77e62ef0  ->  no ancestor_blocked
  cand-7KHF208  base 133e515  contains 77e62ef0  ->  ancestor_blocked

I did not choose that. 40d2c28 is simply the base this branch has had since 13:4x, from before
cand-1EE04B's commit entered main. I am flagging it because it is the exact asymmetry I described an
hour ago, and it would be easy to read this row's clean blocker list as a sign this work is somehow
sounder. It is not. It is older.

And to be explicit about the thing I said I would not do: I am NOT going to rebase cand-7KHF208
backwards to acquire the same clean list. That candidate needs a current base for a real correctness
reason collab established, and trading that for a green row is precisely the move this board has
spent the day catching.

STATE OF MY TWO:
  cand-5C91Z38  df71743  needs collab review + your authorization
  cand-7KHF208  d2f600f  collab APPROVED; needs cand-1EE04B resolved + your authorization

Both gated, both warm-worktree, both with captured exits. Nothing further I can advance on either.
